items.summary: fix(plugins): plugins update reports a version downgrade as a successful update (#127874) * fix(plugins): report version downgrades as downgrades `plugins update` compared only for equality when building update outcomes, so installing an older version than the one already present reported `Updated : -> .` The same equality-only check produced `Updated hook pack ...` for hook packs, which the same command prints through the same renderer. Compare version direction with the release-aware comparator already used to gate bundled-plugin updates, and say "Downgraded" / "Would downgrade" when an install moves backwards. Outcome status is unchanged: consumers read it as "did the install change?", and a downgrade is a change. * test(hooks): track and clean the hook pack fixture directories The parameterized downgrade cases created a temp directory per run with no cleanup. Use the shared tracked temp-dir helper so each case removes what it created.
